import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]/eps + p[4]*T/eps + p[5]*T**2/eps
            + p[6]*eps*T**3 + p[7]*eps**2*T**3 + p[8]*L*eps*T**3 + p[9]*L*T**2)
